title: Do Biased Models Have Biased Thoughts?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating output bias via stereotype reliance in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts (BBQ dataset), and measuring bias in intermediate chain-of-thought reasoning using six methods including LLM-as-a-judge, Natural Language Inference (NLI), and probability distribution divergence (BRAIN).
